definitions.explanation: To a degree that is clearly distinguishable from the previous state or from other things being compared. Emphasizes that the difference is substantial.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{格段|かくだん}に⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{格段|かくだん}に⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I got significantly better grades than last year.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{性能|せいのう}→性能：04340_seinou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十年前|じゅうねんまえ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧{格段|かくだん}に⟦{向上|こうじょう}している→向上する：18997_koujousuru⟧。
examples.english: Smartphone performance has improved dramatically compared to ten years ago.

notes:
Typically modifies verbs or adjectives that describe improvement, difference, or change. Almost always implies a positive or upward change.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {格段|かくだん}に⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ (remarkably better)
- {格段|かくだん}に⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (to rise significantly)
- {格段|かくだん}に⟦{向上|こうじょう}する→向上する：18997_koujousuru⟧ (to improve dramatically)
- {格段|かくだん}に⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧ (to be notably different)

USAGE:
{格段|かくだん}に emphasizes that the gap or improvement is not merely slight but clearly noticeable. It is slightly more formal than ⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧ or はるか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, and is common in written Japanese and formal speech.
